source: Complete GitHub Actions build and deploy job logs and exact remote branch comparison.

graph_metric_definitions.top_level: Unique explicit subject routes after alias normalization, excluding self-links and duplicate targets. Direct parent/child routes remain; legacy lateral_* names are retained for comparison with earlier reports.
graph_metric_definitions.strict_lateral: Explicit routes excluding declared direct parents and direct children. Neither graph includes automatic child routes added by core.connect.
graph_metric_definitions.thin_leaf: No declared children and no outgoing route in the measured graph.
graph_metric_definitions.hygiene_counts: Every self-link occurrence and every duplicate after the first canonical target. A repeated self-link contributes to both counts; both block preflight.
graph_metric_definitions.model_pages: Existing slug-based cohort: subjects ending in -v-arendu.

artifact_path_method: Sorted unique index.html paths extracted from the upload-pages-artifact tar listing in complete build job logs; SHA256 of JSON.stringify(sorted_paths). Compared all path strings, not only their count.

deployment.evidence: The deploy job states Created deployment for the exact head SHA, then Reported success and the evaluated environment URL.

independent_public_html_check.observed_tool_response: URL ... is not accessible via this tool
independent_public_html_check.note: One equivalent Cyrillic-domain retry returned the same limitation. The successful deployment is established by GitHub; these web attempts do not establish public HTTP availability or an outage.

execution_environment.resumption: Preserve and compare stale local changes before synchronizing, or use a fresh isolated checkout of the confirmed remote head.

scope_note: Confirms the exact content commit and its successful deployment. The later documentation checkpoint has its own exact-SHA release gate; no recursive proof-only commit is required.
